tools.name: get_daily_rain_for_month
tools.description: Get daily precipitation data for a specific grid, year, and month. Provides detailed daily measurements with statistics including mean, median, mode, quartiles, and outliers.

grid_id.description: Grid ID for NOAA precipitation data (1-36000). Each grid represents a 0.25-degree geographic area. Grids 6196-34941 cover CONUS landmass; other grids extend into ocean, Mexico, and Canada.

tools.name: get_monthly_rain_total
tools.description: Get monthly precipitation totals for a specific grid. Returns aggregated rainfall data for the entire month.

grid_id.description: Grid ID for NOAA precipitation data (1-36000). Grids 6196-34941 cover CONUS landmass; other grids extend into ocean, Mexico, and Canada.

tools.name: validate_grid
tools.description: Validate that a grid ID is within the valid range for this MCP server. Supports all NOAA precipitation grids 1-36000. Grids 6196-34941 cover CONUS landmass; other grids extend into ocean, Mexico, and Canada.

grid_id.description: Grid ID to validate (1-36000). Grids 6196-34941 are CONUS landmass; others extend to ocean/Mexico/Canada.

tools.name: find_grid_by_coordinates
tools.description: Find the NOAA precipitation grid ID for given latitude and longitude coordinates. Works for coordinates in the extended NOAA grid region covering CONUS plus surrounding ocean, Mexico, and Canada areas.

tools.name: get_grid_info
tools.description: Get detailed information about a specific NOAA precipitation grid, including its geographic boundaries and center coordinates.

grid_id.description: Grid ID for NOAA precipitation data (1-36000). Grids 6196-34941 cover CONUS landmass; other grids extend into ocean, Mexico, and Canada.
